question: A 28-year-old female is brought to the emergency department after being found unconscious outside of a local night club by her friends. On arrival the patient is stuporous. Her temperature is 35°C (95°F), blood pressure is 105/75 mm Hg, pulse is 55/min, and respirations are 10/min. Examination shows dry mucous membranes. The pupils are small and react sluggishly to light. She does not respond to any commands, and painful stimuli cause her to withdraw all extremities. No injection marks can be found on her extremities. The remainder of the examination shows no abnormalities. Which of the following is the most likely cause of her symptoms?
